files.demo.meaning.yaml:
format: meaning/draft-1
id: demo
name: Demo customer and invoice meanings
description: >-
  Meanings used by the saved customer and invoice queries in demo-project-1.
  Shared concepts are reused by immutable address; query usage is recorded
  separately in demo-project-1/datatug-meaning-uses.json.
license: CC0-1.0
concepts:
  - id: customer
    kind: entity
    extends: meaning://github.com/demo-db/chinook/customer?ref=3e7bb316d8a438eb7e5930067997a4e4543a275c
    labels:
      en: Demo customer
    description: A Chinook customer selected in the demo's saved customer queries.

  - id: invoice
    kind: entity
    extends: meaning://github.com/demo-db/chinook/invoice?ref=3e7bb316d8a438eb7e5930067997a4e4543a275c
    labels:
      en: Demo invoice
    description: A Chinook invoice opened from the saved Customer invoices query.

  - id: invoice-line
    kind: entity
    of: invoice
    extends: meaning://github.com/demo-db/chinook/invoice-line?ref=3e7bb316d8a438eb7e5930067997a4e4543a275c
    labels:
      en: Demo invoice line
    description: A purchased track returned by the saved Invoice lines query.

  - id: country
    kind: entity
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/country?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97
    labels:
      en: Demo country
    description: The shared country concept available to this demo's country lookups.

  - id: customer-id
    kind: attribute
    of: customer
    labels:
      en: Customer ID
    description: The CustomerId integer identifying the customer in the saved queries.

  - id: invoice-id
    kind: attribute
    of: invoice
    labels:
      en: Invoice ID
    description: The InvoiceId integer passed from customer invoices to invoice lines.

  - id: customer-country
    kind: attribute
    of: customer
    extends: meaning://github.com/demo-db/chinook/customer-country?ref=3e7bb316d8a438eb7e5930067997a4e4543a275c
    labels:
      en: Customer country
    description: The customer's address country returned by Top Customer Spend.

  - id: invoice-total
    kind: attribute
    of: invoice
    extends: meaning://github.com/demo-db/chinook/invoice-total?ref=3e7bb316d8a438eb7e5930067997a4e4543a275c
    labels:
      en: Invoice total
    description: The amount in USD returned as Total by Customer invoices.

  - id: unit-price
    kind: attribute
    of: invoice-line
    extends: meaning://github.com/demo-db/chinook/unit-price?ref=3e7bb316d8a438eb7e5930067997a4e4543a275c
    labels:
      en: Unit price
    description: The price in USD returned as UnitPrice by Invoice lines.

  - id: quantity
    kind: attribute
    of: invoice-line
    extends: meaning://github.com/demo-db/chinook/quantity?ref=3e7bb316d8a438eb7e5930067997a4e4543a275c
    labels:
      en: Quantity
    description: The number of copies returned as Quantity by Invoice lines.
files.demo-project-1/queries/customers/custome:
from:
  name: Invoice
  alias: i
columns:
  - field: InvoiceId
  - field: InvoiceDate
  - field: BillingCity
  - field: BillingCountry
  - field: Total
where:
  op: ==
  left:
    field: CustomerId
  right:
    param: CustomerId
orderBy:
  - field: InvoiceDate
    desc: true
files.demo-project-1/queries/invoices/invoice-:
SELECT
    il.InvoiceLineId,
    t.Name AS TrackName,
    il.UnitPrice,
    il.Quantity,
    (il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS LineTotal
FROM InvoiceLine AS il
INNER JOIN Track AS t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
WHERE il.InvoiceId = @InvoiceId
ORDER BY il.InvoiceLineId
files.demo-project-1/queries/demodb/chinook-to:
SELECT
    c.CustomerId,
    c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS CustomerName,
    c.Country,
    COUNT(i.InvoiceId) AS InvoiceCount,
    SUM(CAST(ROUND(i.Total * 100) AS INTEGER)) AS TotalCents
FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i
    ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId,c.FirstName,c.LastName,c.Country
ORDER BY TotalCents DESC,c.CustomerId
LIMIT 10

files.assets.meaning.yaml:
format: meaning/draft-1
id: assets
name: Assets and finance
description: >-
  Value and money expressed as reusable concepts: currencies and amounts of
  money.
license: CC0-1.0
concepts:
  - id: currency
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Currency
      ru: Валюта
    synonyms:
      en: [currency code]
      ru: [код валюты]
    description: >-
      A unit of money used to express value, with an ISO 4217 code. Values are
      keyed by the lowercase alphabetic code. Starter subset: three
      currencies. No alias is a bare word or symbol that several currencies
      share ("dollar", "$"): the US dollar is "US dollar", "US dollars" or
      "US$", so another dollar can be added without a collision.
    values:
      - id: usd
        labels: {en: US dollar, ru: Доллар США}
        aliases:
          en: [USD, US$, US dollars, United States dollar]
          ru: [доллары США]
        codes: {alpha: USD, numeric: "840"}
      - id: eur
        labels: {en: Euro, ru: Евро}
        aliases:
          en: [EUR, euros, €]
        codes: {alpha: EUR, numeric: "978"}
      - id: gbp
        labels: {en: Pound sterling, ru: Фунт стерлингов}
        aliases:
          en: [GBP, pounds sterling, sterling]
          ru: [фунты стерлингов]
        codes: {alpha: GBP, numeric: "826"}

  - id: money-amount
    kind: attribute
    units-of: currency
    labels:
      en: Money amount
      ru: Денежная сумма
    synonyms:
      en: [amount, amount of money, sum of money]
      ru: [сумма денег]
    description: >-
      An amount of money. It is only meaningful together with its currency:
      its unit is one of the values of currency, so a concept that extends it
      states the currency as that value (unit: USD), and the check resolves
      the unit to exactly one currency. A dataset that does not store the
      currency must still say which one applies.
files.calendar.meaning.yaml:
format: meaning/draft-1
id: calendar
name: Calendar and time
description: Time concepts that keep their meaning across representations.
license: CC0-1.0
concepts:
  - id: date
    kind: attribute
    labels:
      en: Date
      ru: Дата
    synonyms:
      en: [day, calendar date]
      ru: [день, календарная дата]
    description: >-
      A calendar day: year, month and day, without a time of day. A dataset
      that stores a timestamp whose time is always midnight can treat it as a
      date. Questions that ask "when", "which year" or "which month" group by
      a date.
files.commerce.meaning.yaml:
format: meaning/draft-1
id: commerce
name: Commerce
description: >-
  Buying and selling: customers, orders, invoices, line items, prices and revenue.
license: CC0-1.0
concepts:
  - id: customer
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Customer
      ru: Клиент
    synonyms:
      en: [buyer, client, purchaser, shopper]
      ru: [покупатель, заказчик]
    description: A person or organization that purchases goods or services.

  - id: invoice
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Invoice
      ru: Счёт
    synonyms:
      en: [bill, invoices]
      ru: [счёт-фактура, счета]
    description: >-
      A request for payment for goods or services supplied to a customer: what
      was supplied, when, where it is billed, and the amount charged. Not an
      order (a request to supply) and not a receipt (proof of payment). A
      dataset whose invoices are purchases says so with its own synonyms.

  - id: invoice-line
    kind: entity
    of: invoice
    extends: commercial-line-item
    labels:
      en: Invoice line
      ru: Строка счёта
    synonyms:
      en: [invoice item]
      ru: [позиция счёта]
    description: One item on an invoice, with its unit price and quantity.

  - id: order
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Order
      ru: Заказ
    synonyms:
      en: [sales order, purchase order]
      ru: [заказ на покупку]
    description: >-
      A request or commitment to supply goods or services. An order describes
      intended supply; an invoice requests payment for supplied goods or
      services, and a receipt records payment.

  - id: commercial-line-item
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Commercial line item
      ru: Позиция коммерческого документа
    synonyms:
      en: [line item, line items]
      ru: [позиция]
    description: >-
      One product or service entry on a commercial order or invoice, commonly
      with a quantity and a unit price. It does not by itself specify whether
      the document requests supply or payment.

  - id: order-line
    kind: entity
    of: order
    extends: commercial-line-item
    labels:
      en: Order line
      ru: Строка заказа
    synonyms:
      en: [order item, order detail]
      ru: [позиция заказа]
    description: One product or service requested on an order.

  - id: invoice-total
    kind: attribute
    of: invoice
    extends: money-amount
    labels:
      en: Invoice total
      ru: Сумма счёта
    synonyms:
      en: [total, amount charged, invoice amount]
      ru: [итого]
    description: The amount charged on an invoice, normally the sum of its lines.

  - id: price
    kind: attribute
    extends: money-amount
    labels:
      en: Price
      ru: Цена
    synonyms:
      en: [cost, how much]
      ru: [стоимость]
    description: >-
      The amount asked for one unit of a product or service, such as the list
      price in a catalogue. The amount actually charged on a sale is a
      unit-price.

  - id: unit-price
    kind: attribute
    of: invoice-line
    extends: price
    labels:
      en: Unit price
      ru: Цена за единицу
    synonyms:
      en: [price each, item price]
      ru: [цена за штуку]
    description: The price charged for one unit of an item on an invoice line.

  - id: quantity
    kind: attribute
    of: invoice-line
    labels:
      en: Quantity
      ru: Количество
    synonyms:
      en: [qty, number of items, units]
    description: How many units of an item were sold on one line.
    unit: items

  - id: revenue
    kind: measure
    units-of: currency
    labels:
      en: Revenue
      ru: Выручка
    synonyms:
      en: [sales, sales amount, turnover, takings, spend, purchases, money spent]
      ru: [продажи, объём продаж, оборот, траты, покупки]
    description: >-
      The money received from sales over a period, before costs. From the
      buyer's side the same number is spend, so a question about who buys or
      spends the most asks for revenue grouped by the buyer.
    measure:
      formula: The sum of the invoice totals of the sales in scope.
      aggregation: sum
      inputs: [invoice-total]

files.statistics.meaning.yaml:
format: meaning/draft-1
id: statistics
name: Statistics
description: Derived measures that apply to any dataset.
license: CC0-1.0
concepts:
  - id: per-capita
    kind: measure
    labels:
      en: Per capita
      ru: На душу населения
    synonyms:
      en: [per person, per head, relative to population, per million people, per thousand people]
      ru: [на человека, на миллион человек, относительно населения]
    description: >-
      A pattern, not a number on its own: any measure for a place divided by
      the population of the same place, so that large and small places can
      be compared. It is a ratio, so it is never summed across places. A
      concept that extends it names the measure, the scale and the population
      source and year, and states its unit as the measure's unit per the
      scale's number of people (USD per million people).
    measure:
      formula: >-
        The measure for a place, divided by the population of that place
        (same year where possible), multiplied by the scale (1 for "per
        person", 1,000,000 for "per million people").
      aggregation: none
      inputs: [population]

files.model/chinook.meaning.yaml:
format: meaning/draft-1
id: chinook
name: Chinook music store
description: >-
  What the Chinook sample database means: a digital music store that sells
  tracks to customers in 24 countries. Each concept says what it is, the words
  people use for it, and which ModelSpec record type or field holds it, in which
  role. Concepts that are not specific to Chinook (country, currency,
  customer, invoice, price, revenue, date, population, per capita) are reused
  from the universal concepts at meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core, each
  reference pinned to one commit with ?ref=.
license: CC0-1.0
models:
  chinook: chinook.modelspec.hcl
sources:
  - id: world-bank-population
    provider: World Bank
    dataset: SP.POP.TOTL
    title: Population, total (World Development Indicators)
    year: 2025
    license: CC-BY-4.0
    url: https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.POP.TOTL
    note: >-
      Not part of Chinook. The latest observation per country. As of
      github.com/datatug/chinook-demo commit d2fc437 (data/geo/population_wb),
      the snapshot the DataTug Chinook demo uses, it is 2025 for all 24
      Chinook countries.

concepts:
  # The catalogue

  - id: artist
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Artist
      ru: Исполнитель
    synonyms:
      en: [band, musician, performer, singer, group, act]
      ru: [артист, группа, музыкант]
    description: A recording artist or band, known by its name.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Artist
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Artist
        property: ArtistId
        role: identifier
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Artist
        property: Name
        role: display-name
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Album
        property: ArtistId
        role: foreign-key
        note: The artist of an album.

  - id: album
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Album
      ru: Альбом
    synonyms:
      en: [record, release, LP]
      ru: [пластинка, релиз]
    description: An album by one artist, known by its title.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Album
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Album
        property: Title
        role: display-name
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Track
        property: AlbumId
        role: foreign-key
        note: The album a track is on (the column allows none; every track in this data has one).

  - id: track
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Track
      ru: Трек
    synonyms:
      en: [song, tune, recording, piece of music, video]
      ru: [песня, композиция, запись]
    description: One audio or video track that the store sells, usually on an album.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Track
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Track
        property: Name
        role: display-name
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.InvoiceLine
        property: TrackId
        role: foreign-key
        note: The track bought on an invoice line.

  - id: track-length
    kind: attribute
    of: track
    labels:
      en: Track length
      ru: Длительность трека
    synonyms:
      en: [duration, length, running time, how long]
      ru: [длительность, продолжительность]
    description: How long a track plays.
    unit: milliseconds
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Track
        property: Milliseconds
        role: value

  - id: list-price
    kind: attribute
    of: track
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/price?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97
    labels:
      en: List price
      ru: Цена трека
    synonyms:
      en: [track price, price of a track, how much a track costs]
    description: >-
      The price of one copy of a track in the catalogue (0.99 or 1.99). The
      price actually charged is on the invoice line (see unit-price).
    unit: USD
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Track
        property: UnitPrice
        role: value

  - id: genre
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Genre
      ru: Жанр
    synonyms:
      en: [style, music style, kind of music, category]
      ru: [стиль, направление]
    description: A music genre such as Rock or Jazz, assigned to tracks.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Genre
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Genre
        property: Name
        role: display-name
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Track
        property: GenreId
        role: foreign-key
        note: A track's genre.

  - id: media-type
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Media type
      ru: Формат файла
    synonyms:
      en: [format, file format, file type, encoding, audio format]
      ru: [формат, тип файла]
    description: The file format of a track, such as "MPEG audio file" or "Protected AAC audio file".
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.MediaType
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.MediaType
        property: Name
        role: display-name
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Track
        property: MediaTypeId
        role: foreign-key
        note: A track's media type.

  - id: playlist
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Playlist
      ru: Плейлист
    synonyms:
      en: [play list, collection, mix]
      ru: [подборка, список воспроизведения]
    description: >-
      A named list of tracks. A track can be on many playlists and a playlist
      holds many tracks; PlaylistTrack records which track is on which list.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Playlist
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Playlist
        property: Name
        role: display-name
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.PlaylistTrack
        property: PlaylistId
        role: foreign-key
        note: Playlist membership, one row per track on a playlist.

  # People

  - id: customer
    kind: entity
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/customer?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97
    labels:
      en: Customer
      ru: Клиент
    description: A person who buys music from the store. Some customers name a company.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Customer
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Invoice
        property: CustomerId
        role: foreign-key
        note: The customer who made a purchase.

  - id: customer-country
    kind: attribute
    of: customer
    values-of: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/country?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97
    labels:
      en: Customer country
      ru: Страна клиента
    synonyms:
      en: [where customers live, customer's country, home country]
      ru: [страна проживания]
    description: >-
      The country in the customer's address, as Chinook spells it ("USA",
      "Czech Republic"). For questions about where music is bought, use
      billing-country instead.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Customer
        property: Country
        role: value

  - id: employee
    kind: entity
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/employee?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97
    labels:
      en: Employee
      ru: Сотрудник
    description: A member of the store's staff. Employee.Title is the job title.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Employee
        role: entity

  - id: manager
    kind: attribute
    of: employee
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/manager?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97
    values-of: employee
    labels:
      en: Manager
      ru: Руководитель
    description: The employee someone reports to. Empty for the general manager.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Employee
        property: ReportsTo
        role: foreign-key

  - id: support-rep
    kind: attribute
    of: customer
    values-of: employee
    labels:
      en: Support representative
      ru: Специалист поддержки
    synonyms:
      en: [support rep, sales support agent, account manager, rep]
      ru: [менеджер клиента, сотрудник поддержки]
    description: The employee who looks after a customer.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Customer
        property: SupportRepId
        role: foreign-key

  # Sales

  - id: invoice
    kind: entity
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/invoice?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97
    labels:
      en: Invoice
      ru: Счёт
    synonyms:
      en: [purchase, sale]
      ru: [покупка]
    description: >-
      A billing invoice for tracks purchased by a customer. Chinook has 412
      invoices dated from 2021-01-01 to 2025-12-22. It is an invoice record,
      not the request to supply represented by an order.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Invoice
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.InvoiceLine
        property: InvoiceId
        role: foreign-key
        note: The invoice a line is on.

  - id: invoice-date
    kind: dimension
    of: invoice
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/date?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97
    labels:
      en: Invoice date
      ru: Дата счёта
    synonyms:
      en: [purchase date, when, year, month, sale date]
      ru: [дата покупки, год, месяц]
    description: The date of a purchase. The time part is always midnight.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Invoice
        property: InvoiceDate
        role: value

  - id: billing-country
    kind: dimension
    of: invoice
    values-of: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/country?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97
    labels:
      en: Country
      ru: Страна
    synonyms:
      en: [billing country, country of purchase, where music is bought, buying country]
      ru: [страна покупки, страна покупателя]
    description: >-
      The country an invoice is billed to, as Chinook spells it ("USA",
      "Czech Republic"). Use this one when a question asks which countries buy
      or spend: it is recorded on the sale itself, and it is the column the
      saved per-capita query groups by. In this data it equals the customer's
      country on every invoice, but it would stay right if a customer moved.
      Chinook's spellings are matched to countries by the labels and aliases
      of the universal country concept ("USA" is an alias of United States).
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Invoice
        property: BillingCountry
        role: value
        match: labels

  - id: invoice-line
    kind: entity
    of: invoice
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/invoice-line?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97
    labels:
      en: Invoice line
      ru: Строка счёта
    description: One track bought on an invoice.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.InvoiceLine
        role: entity

  - id: invoice-total
    kind: attribute
    of: invoice
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/invoice-total?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97
    labels:
      en: Invoice total
      ru: Сумма счёта
    description: >-
      The amount charged on an invoice. It equals the sum of UnitPrice x
      Quantity over the invoice's lines (true for all 412 invoices).
    unit: USD
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Invoice
        property: Total
        role: value

  - id: unit-price
    kind: attribute
    of: invoice-line
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/unit-price?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97
    labels:
      en: Unit price
      ru: Цена за единицу
    description: The price charged for one copy of a track on an invoice line.
    unit: USD
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.InvoiceLine
        property: UnitPrice
        role: value

  - id: quantity
    kind: attribute
    of: invoice-line
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/quantity?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97
    labels:
      en: Quantity
      ru: Количество
    description: Copies of a track bought on one invoice line (always 1 in Chinook).
    unit: items
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.InvoiceLine
        property: Quantity
        role: value

  - id: music-sales
    kind: measure
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/revenue?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97
    labels:
      en: Music sales
      ru: Продажи музыки
    synonyms:
      en: [music sales, sales, revenue, spend, how much music, buy the most, buys music]
      ru: [продажи, покупают музыку, выручка]
    description: >-
      Money the store took for music. The data names no currency; Chinook's
      prices (0.99 and 1.99) are read as US dollars.
    unit: USD
    measure:
      formula: >-
        The sum of Invoice.Total over the invoices in scope. Summing
        InvoiceLine.UnitPrice x InvoiceLine.Quantity over the same invoices'
        lines gives the same amount.
      aggregation: sum
      inputs: [invoice-total, unit-price, quantity]
      dimensions: [billing-country, invoice-date]
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Invoice
        property: Total
        role: value

  # Per capita: the hero question
  # "Which countries buy the most music relative to their population?"

  - id: population
    kind: measure
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/population?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97
    source: world-bank-population
    labels:
      en: Population
      ru: Население
    description: >-
      Not in Chinook. The population of each billing country, from the World
      Bank, matched to Chinook's country names through the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2
      code of the universal country concept. A country without a population
      figure drops out of per-capita results.
    unit: people
    measure:
      formula: The World Bank's latest total population of the country.
      aggregation: none
      dimensions: [billing-country]

  - id: music-sales-per-capita
    kind: measure
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/per-capita?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97
    labels:
      en: Music sales per million people
      ru: Продажи музыки на миллион человек
    synonyms:
      en:
        - music sales per capita
        - sales per million people
        - sales per person
        - relative to their population
        - buy the most music relative to population
      ru:
        - продажи на миллион человек
        - продажи на душу населения
        - на душу населения
    description: >-
      Music sales in a country divided by its population, per million people,
      so that small and large countries can be compared. Answers "Which
      countries buy the most music relative to their population?".
    unit: USD per million people
    measure:
      formula: >-
        For each billing country: music sales divided by the country's
        population, multiplied by 1,000,000. The order is highest first.
      aggregation: none
      inputs: [music-sales, population]
      dimensions: [billing-country]
      scale: 1000000
      query: https://github.com/datatug/chinook-demo/blob/main/queries/sales/chinook-sales-per-capita.query.tugql.yaml
